invariants.rule: Deliver the accepted supplied-system execution toolbox, not a biological experiment, new learner, universal identifiability theorem or new execution framework.
Preserve unknown/uncommitted/unmerged work, all successful legacy records and unrelated programs. Selective evidence-backed pruning is allowed; mass deletion, reset/clean and force-push are not.

Real capabilities require source-bound executed evidence. A descriptor, reference-only oracle, fake provider, skipped test, enqueue counter or unselected optimization does not establish a native capability.

Use the existing numerical, identity, preparation and lifetime owners. Project-local claims govern writes; source scopes are coordination boundaries, amendable with conflict checks, not reasons to duplicate implementation.

The root chooses decomposition, ordinary APIs, tests, algorithms, scope transfers and delegation. Explain consequential choices; do not generate procedural microtasks or request routine user direction.
